why: Raw transcripts where the transcription engine got a Dictionary word wrong (misheard: expected_output is the Dictionary spelling that must appear), and transcripts where no Dictionary word was said but one sounds alike (sounds_alike: no Dictionary spelling may appear that the input does not hold). Run with a Dictation mode system prompt.
